dedupe_keys.name: socal 28 bus data set phasor and waveform measurements of an operational distribution network

description: The SoCal 28-bus data set gives phasor and waveform measurements from a real operational distribution network in Southern California. It was published on IEEE DataPort by Yiheng Xie, Lucien Werner, Kaibo Chen, Thuy-Linh Le, Christine Ortega and Steven Low. The circuit has diverse resources (solar, fuel cells, natural gas generators and utility interconnections) and loads (large-scale electric vehicle charging, data centres, central cooling and offices), and records topology changes such as line outages and load transfers. Every bus with non-zero injection is measured, synchronised waveforms support study of harmonics, sub-cycle events and dynamic impedance, and time-varying topology and parameters are included. Coverage is one 28-bus circuit. The files (a sample archive of about 2.45 GB is listed) are downloadable from IEEE DataPort after login, under CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: the abstract calls the data open access, but the page shows a subscription notice and requires a login, and one circuit may not represent other feeders. Simulation uses are distribution state estimation, model validation, event analysis and digital twins. Related records: none linked on the provider's pages read on the day.
